mechanism: Unauthenticated setup/test-downloader accepts an arbitrary HTTP(S) host and performs server-side GET/login requests, including private and loopback targets.

candidate_evidence.origin: 5382aec8dc68dfe5544be50fb811e6e6fb46f1cf created the setup wizard and is explicitly Claude-generated
candidate_evidence.reintroduction: 61ff20fef663aaac88add4f5d72fd560ed6d2abd is Claude-coauthored and removes _validate_url from test_downloader to allow private IPs
candidate_evidence.claimed_fix: 487bdfec545e805ae416e6ddf28651bd274d6a73 is Claude-coauthored but deliberately calls only _validate_scheme

current_evidence: At first-party origin/main fd798519fee7efacfe2d64897e0e8b04f0cee2f2, backend/src/module/api/setup.py still comments that private/loopback IPs stay allowed and calls httpx GET after scheme-only validation.
blockers: No later exact private/loopback containment exists through current main or latest 3.3.5 release
The GitHub advisory is unreviewed and the repository-scoped advisory URL is absent
claim_boundary: Strong AI origin/reintroduction evidence is diagnostic only until an exact same-mechanism fix and released containment exist.

mechanism: validate_network_url used explicit categories including ip.is_private, which does not reject RFC 6598 100.64.0.0/10.

candidate_evidence.preexisting_origin: 4386e344d94c5bd0071ee52732638f6929d59d8a created the first guard without is_private
candidate_evidence.ai_partial: a634475dcb0cd7f4346614dd1f4209bd21592bd5, subject 'Add more Copilot suggestions', adds ip.is_private but still misses CGNAT
candidate_evidence.lineage: a634475d is an ancestor of exact fix 4a820afa

fix_evidence: 4a820afa58810cd05049b6c6eae306694d6cfe65 adds _ip_is_forbidden and returns ip.is_multicast or not ip.is_global; its commit body explicitly names carrier-grade NAT 100.64/10.
blockers: Repository-scoped GHSA URL returns 404; the available GHSA is unreviewed/NVD-sourced, lists patched versions and source code as unknown, and therefore does not satisfy first-party advisory identity
The advisory's claim that current develop is vulnerable conflicts with first-party Git history and v3.10.0 containment
claim_boundary: The AI incomplete-remediation edge and release topology are recovered, but no publication-grade PASS is recommended without first-party advisory identity/reconciliation.

mechanism: Canvas CodeExec evaluated attacker-controlled sandbox stdout.
candidate_evidence: Copilot candidate cbf04ee470333d846ac3c3bc0371eb2690cea0a4 is a 492-file data-pipeline migration; it changes agent/canvas.py but not agent/tools/code_exec.py. The vulnerable eval line in fix-parent blame is d9fe279ddeb3cebef4750cef60b7a3286a492238.
fix_evidence: First-party fix 7a344a32f9f83529e12ca12f40f2657eb79fe811 removes eval and uses json.loads/ast.literal_eval in agent/tools/code_exec.py.
claim_boundary: Reject cbf04ee as the causal edge; do not convert absence of public AI attribution on d9fe279d into a class-wide NOT_AI_CAUSAL claim.

mechanism: Untrusted remote-source URL data was rendered through v-html in StudyList.vue.
candidate_evidence: Copilot candidate f2bbed1d805361713d9b721b65141b5bf5bc0cf6 changes only default config and locale/i18n files. The unsafe assignment blames to d697e190 and v-html lines to 547cb7b6, both outside the candidate.
claim_boundary: Reject the locale candidate; this is not a claim-grade negative for every possible origin.

mechanism: Embedded DNS forwarded queries without consulting the sandbox HTTP(S) egress allowlist.
candidate_evidence: Claude candidate 363373d657b24e3239ef8fe5bd2913006d5ae48f changes README.md only; bound root e4809b108ff941fbd3dc8ab1edd8755af78ddc07 is also README-only.
fix_evidence: No source-code fix was recoverable from the release-only repository; structural recovery recorded a missing promisor object for affected-file history.
blockers: Release repository does not contain the DNS implementation or an exact fix member
Promisor history gap prevents complete local source recovery
claim_boundary: The README edge is rejected diagnostically, but the component stays blocked because actual origin/fix lineage is unavailable.

mechanism: get_excel_path accepted absolute paths and joined relative traversal under EXCEL_FILES_PATH without containment.
candidate_evidence: Claude candidate e50532296bcb4d9658154d5ab89e57b0f4d2fa07 only adds MCP tool annotations in server.py. Vulnerable get_excel_path originates in 4e82b8a7b2366f1c91615cf64599c5612972f7b4 and SSE setup in bbab5bf1.
fix_evidence: f51340ecd5778952405044b203d3a2d4c8a46833 adds realpath/commonpath confinement, rejects absolute paths in SSE mode, and adds sandbox tests.
claim_boundary: Reject the annotation-only candidate; keep the class label UNKNOWN rather than treating unattributed origin as proof of human causality.

mechanism: Low-privilege app-config responses exposed Google Calendar service-account private-key material without obfuscation.
candidate_evidence: Claude candidate 5bf82e29354d8c53c6e8d839b9583a142164a569 adds device_status/action_pending host API fields and does not modify Google Calendar key storage or AppConfig.Obfuscate.
fix_evidence: 23fc6804efe785f806f769d6be1f5f05b2e13ec2 adds Google Calendar API-key masking/preservation across calendar and app-config paths.
claim_boundary: A generic shared integration-test path is not a mechanism edge; reject the named candidate only.

mechanism: The image proxy fetched an attacker-provided URL without SSRF validation.
candidate_evidence: Claude candidate a37c6bc8121a75fb4a8a844369e43a44f8501644 changes only .github/workflows/build.yml and bun.lock; the prior carrier fd6d927228a7ea10a67886390f210922f7771801 is not the disclosed code fix.
fix_evidence: 3424a338b763115f0269b209e777608e4cd31785 adds validateImageUrl before fetch in apps/sim/app/api/proxy/image/route.ts; route history predates the candidate.
claim_boundary: Reject the build-only candidate; no class-wide negative follows from that rejection.

mechanism: Magic-link/email-OTP verification preserved an attacker's pre-registered password and sessions.
candidate_evidence: 5c6ccfa688a93ab10af1683fc7a37f9fdab8cd83 is a docs rewrite; 6c83eca2a003e435cf09748b66d2da828f824c51 is an adapter-factory move. Neither changes magic-link/email-OTP verification or credential revocation.
fix_evidence: c06a56d83a40bbaeac12d3a8b8b67e59f92a9110 invokes revokeUnprovenAccountAccess before marking an account verified in both passwordless flows.
claim_boundary: Reject both routed edges; the unobserved exact origin remains outside a class-negative claim.

mechanism: Debug logs exposed STS session_token through Credentials::Debug and response credentials through s3s Body::Once debug formatting.
candidate_evidence: Copilot candidates 064e21062dc64a12825710461c493a3b4e19a951 and 6ce24f3b632f86c456a95d6e8b6ba9d05c8e4ae5 concern capacity/lifecycle code, not credential logging. The partial human remediation 2108c4ad2810418ba418ea67e75615fe6048ed46 masks secret_key but leaves session_token plaintext.
fix_evidence: 66c38b629d4a3453dec14d60cb0d5c32acc19085, Copilot-Autofix coauthored, masks session_token and first appears in 1.0.0-beta.2. The audit's 9f070293 carrier is not the atomic fix. However beta.1 and beta.2 pin the same s3s a3b16608df35aaeed8fff08b4988d03f4ca9445b, whose Body::Once debug still prints raw bytes; owned clone origin/main d7028511 also retains it.
blockers: Only one of the advisory's two named leakage sites is demonstrably closed in beta.2
The claimed external s3s redaction is absent from the identical pinned revision and current first-party s3s main
claim_boundary: Both routed candidates are rejected, but incomplete released containment prevents resolving the component.

mechanism: Idefics3 image preprocessing used the wrong input channel order for a 1x1 edge case, causing tensor mismatch and process termination.
candidate_evidence: Five AI candidates (0ff902f3, 3461e7ef, 49252cf5, 4ccffe56, c4afdb69) are buffer/config/worker/refactor changes and none modifies vllm/model_executor/models/idefics3.py. Their bound 4fd9d6a8 carrier is not the atomic channel-order fix.
fix_evidence: 0ec84221718d920c3f46da879cc354f94b8fb59e sets input_data_format=channels_last in idefics3.py; vulnerable image-processing lines predate all five routed candidates.
claim_boundary: Reject all five routed candidates; an AI-assisted repair is not evidence that AI created the vulnerability.

mechanism: SSE and stateful Streamable HTTP routed an existing session by ID without checking the authenticated principal that created it.
candidate_evidence: Five Claude candidates are tool removal, task-capability backport, pagination, sampling-with-tools, and test-readiness changes. Even where tests/session.py overlap, none adds the HTTP session-ID routing without owner binding. SSE originates in 4cbf8154306aa5b96b2bb3fc83ac5984d217a0f5; Streamable HTTP manager in e4e119b32454b4bf7d72de28c1eb0559875caaf5.
fix_evidence: 1abcca2408a6b50e10ec601181f63f9978705c00 adds subject/claims to authorization context; ce267b6fc515dc4efc1dc70b6975b16ff0feef0a binds SSE and HTTP sessions to that context and rejects mismatches. Released in v1.27.2.
claim_boundary: Reject all five named candidates; origin attribution remains unknown rather than human by default.
